brief:
Michigan rabbis issued a petition declaring demands that Michigan gubernatorial candidate Abdul El-Sayed disown streamer Hasan Piker "nonnegotiable," according to Mondoweiss. The rabbis' action follows El-Sayed's efforts to distance himself from critics of Israeli policy, reflecting what observers describe as an impossible standard: that no public disavowal will satisfy opponents seeking to purge anti-Zionism from Democratic politics entirely.

The petition demonstrates the limits of conciliation for El-Sayed and other figures facing pressure from groups demanding explicit rejection of Palestinian advocacy positions. Critics argue the escalating demands reveal an underlying goal to eliminate anti-Zionist voices from mainstream Democratic circles rather than to resolve specific policy disputes.
dek: A Michigan rabbis' 'nonnegotiable' petition demanding El-Sayed disown Hasan Piker reveals a harsh truth for El-Sayed: that no amount of pandering will satisfy critics who want anti-Zionism expelled from the Democratic party outright.
title: Michigan rabbis demand El-Sayed disown Hasan Piker over anti-Zionism
